about: What the release's app payload may weigh, packed as the archive packs it (each staged file deflated at level 9, in MiB; the bundled runtime is not counted). tests/test_release_size.py holds it and prints the bytes per group when it is over. Raise a number when a feature earns it. Measured for v0.6.22's tree: standard 2.15, advanced adds 1.58.
